operative_excerpt: The President shall from time to time, as appropriate, embody in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States the substance of the relevant provisions of this chapter
rationale: The 1988 amendment changed tariff nomenclature rather than the recipient of the power.

operative_excerpt: The President may exercise any functions conferred upon him by this chapter through such agency or officer of the United States Government as he shall direct. The head of any such agency or such officer may from time to time promulgate such rules
rationale: The section independently empowers the President to exercise or delegate functions and agency heads to promulgate rules and redelegate.

operative_excerpt: Returns and return information shall be confidential
rationale: Subsection (a) imposes a confidentiality rule and does not confer an affirmative power on the President or an agency.

operative_excerpt: the President, from time to time, may place in levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule positions held by not to exceed 34 individuals
rationale: The provision expressly assigns the placement decision to the President.

operative_excerpt: the Secretary of Agriculture has reason to believe that any article or articles are being or are practically certain to be imported | "the President shall by proclamation impose such fees"
rationale: The section assigns the Secretary an independent threshold assessment and the President the operative import restriction.

operative_excerpt: The President may—(1) prescribe such regulations for the admission of individuals into the civil service in the executive branch
rationale: The statutory authorization runs to the President; the Department of Defense acts only if the President authorizes it.

rationale: Before the 1996 amendment the cited subsection conferred the operative suspension power only on the President.

rationale: Public Law 104-208 added an independent Attorney General suspension power to subsection (f).

operative_excerpt: the Secretary of Commerce shall immediately initiate an appropriate investigation | "the President shall determine whether the President concurs with the finding of the Secretary"
rationale: The whole section assigns an investigation to the Secretary and the resulting adjustment decision to the President.

operative_excerpt: the President, whenever he finds as a fact that any existing duties or other import restrictions of the United States or any foreign country are unduly burdening and restricting the foreign trade of the United States
rationale: The operative agreement and proclamation authority is expressly conferred on the President.

operative_excerpt: The President shall be authorized, in the light of the functions performed by any such international organization, by appropriate Executive order to withhold or withdraw
rationale: The designation withdrawal and limitation powers are expressly assigned to the President.

operative_excerpt: The President may prescribe rules governing the competitive service.
rationale: The provision expressly assigns rulemaking authority to the President.

operative_excerpt: he may appoint a board of inquiry to inquire into the issues involved in the dispute
rationale: The antecedent of he is the President; the board receives an inquiry assignment but no independent statutory power.

operative_excerpt: the President may make provision—(A) for purchases of or commitments to purchase an industrial resource or a critical technology item
rationale: The affirmative transaction and determination authorities are assigned to the President.

operative_excerpt: the President shall take all appropriate and feasible action within his power which the President determines will facilitate efforts by the domestic industry
rationale: The interagency body recommends; the statute assigns the operative safeguard decision to the President.

operative_excerpt: the President may direct the drawdown of such articles, services, and military education and training
rationale: The drawdown power is expressly assigned to the President; agencies supply inventory and implementation.
